overview_description.description: CERO - Centro Especializado em Radiologia Odontológica is a specialized dental radiology clinic. It provides a range of services in the field of dentistry, including intraoral radiographs, dental radiographs, cone beam tomography, intraoral scanning, and 3D printing. In addition to diagnostic services, CERO also offers courses and lectures, contributing to the professional development of dental practitioners. It operates multiple units, ensuring accessibility and convenience for its clients.
